conviction_note: The evidence is small and points both ways. Negatives: Sanofi's Q3 flu/COVID phasing into Q4, and Pfizer's US Comirnaty down 35% on narrower recommendations. Positives: the $125m CIC milestone, already public on Oct 29 and anticipated since Oct 12, and a crowded short (about 47m shares, 28.7% of shares outstanding) on a name that rose on 6 of its last 8 prints. Downside skew of +7.28 vol points offsets the squeeze-and-history lean, so p_up sits at 50 and the scaled number is 0. The findings sum to +0.6, mostly the positioning item; that gap is the squeeze argument, which the skew disputes.
bar: Disputed, so every finding is capped small. Earnings Whispers (2026-10-29) puts Q3 revenue at about $50.6m and EPS at -$0.33: https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/NVAX/22450. Chartmill puts revenue at $78.7m and EPS at -$0.22, with the revenue estimate revised down 22.5% over three months: https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/NVAX/estimates. Benzinga has EPS at -$0.21. The company guides no quarter. Its FY2026 Adjusted Total Revenue framework is $235-275m, raised on Aug 6 from $230-270m, and excludes Sanofi supply sales, royalties and milestones: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001000694/000100069426000019/prfinal.htm. H1 total revenue was $197m (Q1 $140m, Q2 $57m), so the framework implies only about $40-80m of adjusted revenue for all of H2. My print_vs_bar is against the $50.6m figure and is low-confidence.
positioning_check: Short interest is 47,348,523 shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, up 1.30m from 09-30. That is about 28.7% of the 164.95m shares outstanding. Days to cover are 4.3 on the elevated October volume (10.9m/day) and 8.1 at the 09-30 settlement (equibles, FINRA data, page snapshot 2026-11-04: https://equibles.com/stocks/nvax/shortinterest). This is a crowded short. The baseline options show 25d skew at +7.28 vol points (downside paid), a put/call OI ratio of 0.52, ATM IV 167%, an event-implied move of 10.77%, and an ATM spread of 70% of mid, so the implied move is indicative only. Shah Capital, the former activist, sold 2.87m shares at an average $11.35 and moved to 13G (13D/A filed 2026-10-16); it still holds 10.5m shares (6.4%).

findings.finding: Sanofi's Q3 2026 release puts its influenza and COVID-19 vaccine sales at EUR1,256m, down 18.8% at CER: US EUR911m (-13.4%), Europe EUR243m (-32.0%). It says Northern Hemisphere seasonal deliveries are phased toward Q4 this year, and its Oct 6 aide-memoire blames 'atypical strain selection timelines'. Nuvaxovid is sold by Sanofi and pays Novavax high-teens to low-twenties royalties plus supply sales. Those Sanofi lines are excluded from Novavax's revenue framework and are the unguided part of the Q3 number, which suggests Q3 Sanofi royalties and supply sales tilt low against Q3 2025, when the Sanofi line was $48m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sanofi royalties have been tiny so far: $0.7m in Q2 2026 and $4.2m in H1 per the 10-Q. The last two big up-moves (+17.4% Feb 2026, +15.6% May 2026) came on framework beats and raises, not on Sanofi lines. A 2026 framework raise in Aug bought +0.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus for NVAX Q3 revenue ranges from $50.6m to $78.7m, and the Chartmill figure has been cut 22.5% in three months, so part of this is probably in the lower estimates. No NVAX preview I found cites Sanofi's Q4 phasing. If it were priced, the estimates would agree near the low end and the previews would mention Sanofi's phasing.
findings.independence: Sanofi's own Q3 aide-memoire (2026-10-06) says the same about phasing: https://www.sanofi.com/assets/dotcom/content-app/events/quaterly-results/2026/2026-q3-2026-results/20261006-Sanofi-Q3-2026-Aide-memoire.pdf. It is the same company and the same fact, so it counts once. Phasing to Q4 also means the shortfall partly reverses next quarter, which is why this is small.

findings.finding: Pfizer's Q3 2026 release (Nov 3) reports US Comirnaty revenue of $562m, down 35% from $870m, 'primarily resulting from narrower vaccine recommendations'. The 2026-27 formula is approved only for adults 65+ and high-risk people aged 5-64, and there is no functioning ACIP recommendation (AJMC, 2026-10-01). This is an independent read on the US COVID vaccine market for the 2026-27 season, on which Sanofi's Nuvaxovid sales, and so Novavax's royalties and any commentary on the US season, depend. Pfizer released after Novavax last spoke.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no separable precedent. The stock fell on the Nov 2025 print (-1.3%) when COVID vaccine weakness under US policy was the theme, and the Feb 2025 print (-3.55%) also came on a weak COVID outlook.
findings.why_not_priced: Pfizer reported only one session before this print, and NVAX closed +7% on Nov 4 (equibles snapshot), so the market did not visibly mark NVAX down on the peer's US number. If priced, NVAX would have weakened after Nov 3, and previews would ask about the US season rather than only the milestones.
findings.independence: This is a proxy, a peer product, and Novavax and Sanofi have not confirmed the transmission. Sanofi's Q3 shows US flu/COVID down 13.4% (a separate source, same direction), but Sanofi attributes that to timing rather than demand. The AJMC piece on there being no functioning ACIP is here: https://www.ajmc.com/view/who-recommends-covid-19-vaccines-without-acip-goad-pharmd

findings.finding: The 8-K of Oct 29 records that Sanofi dosed the fifth patient in the EU Phase 3 flu-COVID combination trial on Oct 28, 2026. That triggers a $125m milestone to Novavax, about 49% of the $255m framework midpoint, with payment expected by Q1 2027. It is Q4 revenue, not Q3, and is excluded from the framework. On the call it can lift FY2026 total revenue and the cash runway and settle doubts about Sanofi's commitment after its CEO change.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Earlier Sanofi milestone news moved the stock strongly: +19% on the May 2025 $175m BLA approval milestone. This one was anticipated. Reports of EU regulators clearing the trial ran from about Oct 12 (finanztrends), and the stock fell from $12.82 (Oct 15) to about $9.6 (Oct 22) anyway, then sat near $10.3 around the Oct 29 announcement.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it has been public for a week and expected for three. What is not priced is how management folds it into a total-revenue figure, the 2026 cash path and the profitability timeline. The framework excludes Sanofi milestones, so consensus models may not carry it in FY2026. If fully priced, the stock would have re-rated on Oct 29, and it did not.
findings.independence: The Earnings Whispers preview (2026-10-29) flags the CIC milestone and Sanofi's continued interest as the key questions: https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/NVAX/22450. Contract Pharma covers the trial start (2026-10-29).

findings.finding: Shah Capital, the activist holder, sold 2.87m shares at an average $11.35 (as of Oct 5), withdrew its adviser registration and moved from 13D to 13G on Oct 16. It still holds 10.5m shares (6.4%), a potential further supply overhang.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None on prints. The stock fell 10.4% on Oct 16, the filing day; Citi reiterated Sell with an $8 target on Oct 15.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced on Oct 16. What remains is whether the holder sells its remaining 10.5m shares into any post-print strength, which caps upside on a good print. If fully priced, the 13G overhang would not be discussed, and nothing shows that.
findings.independence: The 13G filed the same day (accession 0001398344-26-018328) is the same holder, so it counts once.

findings.why_not_priced: The option market pays for downside (skew +7.28). That suggests the squeeze leg is underpriced relative to the history, though it may be right if the quarter disappoints. If the squeeze were priced, skew would be flat or call-side.
findings.independence: Earlier FINRA-based readings (curvedtrading, 2026-08-14: 47.5m shares, DTC 14.0; equibles, Aug 20: 27.7% of float) agree on a persistently crowded short. Same data family.

findings.finding: Novavax has raised its revenue framework at most recent prints: FY2025 at Aug and Nov 2025, and FY2026 from $230-270m to $235-275m on Aug 6, 2026, while cutting combined R&D+SG&A guidance by $10m. H1 2026 total revenue of $197m already sits near the bottom of the FY adjusted range, which makes another small raise or a firmed range likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Aug 2026 raise bought +0.52%. The Nov 2025 raise bought -1.3%. The May 2026 reiteration plus beat bought +15.56%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly inside what the company has already guided. The only unpriced part is the size of a raise, and the last two raises were not paid for.
findings.independence: The Q3 2025 release (2025-11-06) shows the FY2025 framework raised from $1,000-1,050m to $1,040-1,060m: https://ir.novavax.com/press-releases/2025-11-06-Novavax-Reports-Third-Quarter-2025-Financial-Results-and-Operational-Highlights?asPDF=1

findings.finding: The Q2 2026 10-Q says up to $92.5m of Australia APA deferred revenue ($48.4m current, $85.4m non-current) may become refundable if the updated vaccine is not approved and delivered by contractual deadlines, and that the company is 'awaiting a final decision' on a TGA special importation application. Any resolution in Q3 would land as a one-off: either a release into revenue or a refund liability.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No precedent on this item. Earlier APA close-outs (Q1 2025, $603m non-cash) were treated as non-cash and looked through.
findings.why_not_priced: It is buried in a footnote, and no preview mentions it. The sign is unknown and the item is non-cash or below the line in substance, so it is sized at zero with a wide band.
findings.independence: None found. No 2026 TGA decision turned up in search.

lessons_applied: Rule 6 (disputed bar: EW $50.6m/-0.33 against Chartmill $78.7m/-0.22): capped every finding at |0.8| or less; the short-interest finding went from +1.0 to +0.8.
